P2.title: Retained Search State Before Neural Architecture: Prospective Transfer in Supply-Chain Resilience Simulation Optimization
P2.thesis: Retained outer-loop search state can reduce development regret, but prospective transfer is carrier-specific and the evaluated neural carrier adds no demonstrated transfer advantage.
